### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Python Engineer building calculation logic, APIs, and cloud infrastructure for ComboCurve’s energy-sector economics platform. Owning features from design through deployment and monitoring.
Senior Python Engineer building cloud economics software for energy-sector asset evaluation
- Tech stack: Cloud, Docker, Flask, Google Cloud Platform, GRPC, MongoDB, Numpy, Pandas, Python

- Write efficient Python code on structured time series datasets that scales across cloud infrastructure
- Own features end-to-end, from scoping and design through implementation, deployment, and monitoring
- Participate in software and infrastructure system design discussions and architectural decisions
- Build and maintain reliable, well-tested Python backend services and APIs
- Model, query, and optimize MongoDB data through schema design, indexing, and aggregation pipelines
- Deploy and operate containerized services on cloud infrastructure
- Use GCP components including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and GCS
- Incorporate AI-first development practices and AI tooling

- Experience designing REST or gRPC APIs with OpenAPI contracts and versioning
- Hands-on Flask and/or FastAPI experience

- Practical knowledge of SOLID principles and clean architecture
- Experience with pandas or numpy for statistical and exploratory data analysis

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Python Engineer building calculation logic, APIs, and cloud infrastructure for ComboCurve’s energy-sector economics platform. Owning features from design through deployment and monitoring.
Senior Python Engineer building cloud economics software for energy-sector asset evaluation
Role description:
• Write efficient Python code on structured time series datasets that scales across cloud infrastructure
• Own features end-to-end, from scoping and design through implementation, deployment, and monitoring
• Participate in software and infrastructure system design discussions and architectural decisions
• Build and maintain reliable, well-tested Python backend services and APIs
• Model, query, and optimize MongoDB data through schema design, indexing, and aggregation pipelines
• Deploy and operate containerized services on cloud infrastructure
• Use GCP components including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and GCS
• Incorporate AI-first development practices and AI tooling
• Collaborate through code reviews, technical documentation, and shared engineering standards
Role requirements:
• Production-grade Python 3.13+ with type annotations and async/await
• Experience designing REST or gRPC APIs with OpenAPI contracts and versioning
• Hands-on Flask and/or FastAPI experience
• Experience configuring Gunicorn for WSGI deployment
• Practical knowledge of SOLID principles and clean architecture
• Experience with pandas or numpy for statistical and exploratory data analysis
• Ability to efficiently process medium-to-large datasets and communicate findings through visualizations or reports
• Experience delivering features to production in cloud-based SaaS products
• Production MongoDB experience including schema design, indexing, and aggregation pipelines
• Experience with MongoEngine or PyMongo
• Hands-on experience with uv or similar dependency management tools
• Comprehensive pytest testing, including fixtures, parameterization, and mocked external services
• Docker and Docker Compose experience
• Experience enforcing code quality with ruff and pyright
• Ability to take ownership from scoping through shipping and iteration
• Ability to translate ambiguous product requirements into technical proposals
• Ability to communicate tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ability to conduct code reviews that improve quality and share context
Tech stack:
Cloud, Docker, Flask, Google Cloud Platform, GRPC, MongoDB, Numpy, Pandas, Python
